skill.name: skill-builder
skill.description: Create Claude Code skills with valid SKILL.md frontmatter, correct directory placement, progressive disclosure, templates, and validation checklists. Use when drafting new skills, standardizing team skills, or reviewing skill structure before publishing.
skill.summary: Build well-structured Claude Code skills with templates, structure guidance, and validation checks.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: The audit found no prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious network behavior in the skill text. Most static hits are Markdown code fences, inline formatting, placeholder links, or relative documentation links. The real risk is that the skill intentionally guides writes to persistent .claude/skills locations, which can affect future agent behavior.

remediation.issue: Persistent writes to Claude skill directories
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before creating or editing ~/.claude/skills or project .claude/skills, and show the exact target path.

remediation.issue: Command examples may be copied into agent actions
remediation.suggestion: Label shell blocks as examples and instruct agents to ask before running setup, install, deploy, or package commands.

remediation.issue: Generated skills may inherit unsafe patterns
remediation.suggestion: Add review guidance for prompt injection, external commands, network calls, and hidden file writes before installing generated skills.

remediation.issue: Placeholder external links appear in templates
remediation.suggestion: Replace example.com links before publishing generated skills, or mark them clearly as placeholders.

static_findings.snippet: **Critical**: Only `name` and `description` are used by Claude. Additional fields are ignored.

content.value_statement: Creating agent skills requires exact frontmatter, directory placement, and progressive disclosure. This skill gives Claude and Codex structured templates, checks, and examples for building usable Claude Code skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md frontmatter fields and formatting rules.
Shows personal and project skill directory structures for Claude Code.
Provides basic, intermediate, and advanced skill templates.
Describes progressive disclosure levels and when to move content into referenced files.
Includes a validation checklist for structure, content quality, and testing.
Links to official Claude skill documentation and related community resources.
limitations: It does not include automation scripts that create files by itself.
It does not validate YAML syntax or run tests automatically.
It assumes current Claude Code skill directory conventions.
Writing to .claude skill paths should require explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Draft a Personal Skill
use_cases.description: Create a new Claude Code skill with valid frontmatter, clear triggers, and a minimal SKILL.md structure.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Skills
use_cases.description: Define shared project skill layouts, documentation sections, and validation checks for a team repository.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Packages
use_cases.description: Check an existing skill for required metadata, top-level placement, progressive disclosure, and publish readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal Claude Code skill for this workflow: [describe workflow]. Include the skill name, trigger description, and main SKILL.md sections.

prompt_templates.title: Add Structure and Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my draft skill and improve its frontmatter, directory structure, quick start, and validation checklist. Keep the instructions concise.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-File Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Claude Code skill that uses SKILL.md plus supporting docs, templates, and examples. Explain what belongs in each file.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Marketplace Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this skill package for clarity, progressive disclosure, hidden file writes, external commands, and marketplace readiness. Provide prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Create a new README generator skill for project documentation.
output_examples.output: A concise skill plan with a name, trigger description, required sections, directory placement, and a validation checklist.

output_examples.input: Review my existing SKILL.md before I share it with my team.
output: Structure and progressive disclosure gaps are grouped by severity.
Recommended edits focus on clear triggers and safer file operations.

output_examples.input: Design an advanced React component generator skill.
output_examples.output: A package outline with core instructions, supporting templates, examples, troubleshooting notes, and testing guidance.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md focused on triggers, core workflow, and links to deeper references.
Use exact directory names and explain whether a skill is personal or project-scoped.
Ask for confirmation before creating or editing files under .claude paths.
anti_patterns: Do not bury trigger words in long descriptions that Claude may not match reliably.
Do not put large examples or reference material directly in the main SKILL.md file.
Do not run install, setup, or deploy commands without user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build Claude Code skills with valid frontmatter, clear instructions, templates, and validation steps.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions and examples. File creation should happen only after explicit user approval.

faq.question: Can it help with project-scoped skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains project .claude skill locations and when to use them for shared team workflows.

faq.question: Can it validate a finished skill?
faq.answer: It provides a checklist, but it does not run a validator or execute tests by itself.

faq.question: Does it support Claude and Codex users?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is useful when Claude or Codex needs to author or review Claude Code skill packages.

faq.question: What safety step matters most?
faq.answer: Confirm the exact target path before writing to personal or project .claude skill directories.
